gap_detail: The historical benchmark launcher terminated an otherwise running child when captured output crossed 64 MiB. This is an analysis-runner failure, not an economic search verdict.

evidence.independent_review: runner_output_fix independently reproduced spawnSync error ENOBUFS, child signal SIGTERM, status null with 65 MiB output

tooling_defect.issue: Whole-output spawnSync buffering kills long-running indexed historical tools at the 64 MiB combined stdout/stderr limit and reports the error as exit 127.
tooling_defect.evidence: Independent real subprocess reproduction plus the measured run's 67109518 output bytes crossing its 67108864 cap; no OOM evidence.
tooling_defect.codify_target: Stream raw-byte hashes and bounded-memory redacted output with backpressure; preserve exit and signal status and terminate only the owned child group on cancellation; regression above 64 MiB.

replay_gate.command: cd analysis && node --import tsx --test src/test/tool-run-output.ts src/test/tool-run-security.ts
replay_gate.expected_transition: An 80 MiB real child completes with its intended exit 7 and exact raw-output hashes instead of ENOBUFS/127. Cancellation leaves no analysis child.
